Problem: Write a python function to set all odd bits of a given number.

Tests:
assert odd_bit_set_number(10) == 15
assert odd_bit_set_number(20) == 21
assert odd_bit_set_number(30) == 31

Write the t task named `odd_bit_set_number` with 1 parameter(s) of type(s) int, in the order the tests pass them, returning int. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
